references.title: NICE PH49: goals and planning
references.summary: NICE recommends agreeing behavior goals, specifying action plans, prioritizing actions, and considering coping plans. Plans should reflect individual needs.
references.applicability: Explaining a user-controlled priority or hypothetical plan.
references.limitations: Guidance for behavior-change interventions; it does not establish Cadence efficacy or prove that any proposed time is suitable. No medical advice.

references.title: Cadence: manual truth
references.summary: An unresolved occurrence records no decision. Invite a review without describing it as a failure. Suggestions never change the record.
references.limitations: Product editorial guidance, not research evidence or a claim of effectiveness.
